description: Shiv Vyas a student of CE Department, SVIT Vasad under the guidance of Dr. Neha Soni (HOD CE. Dept.,) was selected to showcase his innovative projects namely “Economical Deployable Optical Network Communication System for Space and Water”. In this, he developed a secured and economical system which can be used by astronauts and scuba-divers for communication with each other in space or underwater, for faster transfer of data from space to earth and from ocean to earth surface, communication of different aircraft and Submarines with each other. This system can be used to communicate with any lost astronaut or spaceship in space or a lost ship or diver in ocean. Shiv Vyas has bagged the 5th Prize in the ProjectExpo 2019, Surat and has awarded a cash prize of Rupees 10,000 for the project “Economical Deployable Optical Network Communication System for Space and Water”.

title: 1st Runner-Up – The Urban Innovation Challenge 2025
description:
A team of 10 students from the Fourth Year, Department of Architecture, SVIT - VASAD, achieved the 1st Runner-Up position in The Urban Innovation Challenge 2025, a prestigious national-level design competition themed “Resilient Development” under the Student Category.

The competition was jointly launched by Municipalika and The Good Governance India Foundation (GGIF), with Daikin as the Associate Partner and ETHOS EMPOWER as the supporting partner.

The students’ proposal was recognized for its innovative, sustainable, and forward-thinking urban design approach, addressing key challenges of resilience in contemporary urban development. This achievement highlights the department’s commitment to design excellence, research-driven solutions, and responsible urban innovation.
